deliverySummary: Re-refined Claude's Machine-Generated Repo Catalog to ESTATE-SPEC-STD-V2, closed all 3 specification loopholes, and surfaced 1-click Whole-Repo Export (.tar.gz, .bundle, catalog JSON) in the Founder UI.
instructionsRunbook: 1. Boot & Resuscitate All 4 Agent Services: node bin/estate-service-up
2. Poll Consulting Lane Inbox & Promote to Outbox: node bin/estate-inbox-poll
3. Verify Spec Standard & Instructions (Gate G1..G7): node bin/estate-spec-enforce && node bin/estate-push-instructions
4. Deterministic Rollback: git checkout main -- register/machine-repo-catalog.json bin/estate-catalog-export
